summary: Join our International Pension Standards and Regulations Training Course to master the latest global pension regulations and boost your career prospects.
lede: Pension fund law and regulation training covers the rules and standards shaping scheme design, governance, funding and oversight. For pension managers, administrators, trustees, HR and finance professionals, it builds practical skills in interpreting international frameworks, assessing governance and funding arrangements, identifying compliance gaps, and explaining pension decisions clearly to boards, members and supervisors.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly engage with pension design, administration, regulation, or oversight and must understand international standards and regulatory expectations. This course is designed for: Pension fund managers and administrators. HR and compensation managers responsible for staff retirement benefits. Finance and corporate services managers overseeing pension liabilities. Trustees and board members of pension schemes. Regulators and supervisors in pension or financial services authorities. Social security and public pension scheme officials. Compliance and legal officers working on benefits and retirement plans. Actuarial, audit, and consulting professionals advising on pension matters. NGO and international organization staff managing staff pension arrangements. Policy makers and analysts involved in pension reforms and retirement policy.
modules: Global Pension Landscape and Core Principles
Pension Scheme Design and Member Protection
Cross Border Pensions, Portability, and International Workers
Reform, Policy Change, and Stakeholder Engagement
Communicating Pension Decisions and Complex Rules Clearly
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of pension schemes and retirement benefits. Prior experience in finance, HR, or legal roles related to pension management is beneficial.
